intent: Allow generated zsh completions to be sourced dynamically while retaining normal autoload behavior, and document both installation methods.

findings.title: Run completion initialization before sourcing the generated script
findings.suggested_fix: Document that compinit must run before the source command; also place the fpath addition before compinit for the file-based approach.
findings.first_evidence: FAQ.md:132: add the following to your `$HOME/.zshrc` file:
findings.why_it_matters: A user who adds the command before compinit, or has not initialized the completion system, gets an _arguments error at shell startup and no rg completion. The script calls _rg when compdef is absent, so the instructions need to specify the initialization order.
evidence: FAQ.md:132: add the following to your `$HOME/.zshrc` file:
In zsh -f, sourcing the completion without compinit returns status 1 with _arguments: command not found.

findings.title: Remove the prompt character from the zshrc command
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the leading `$ ` from the line intended for .zshrc.
findings.why_it_matters: The instructions say to add this line to .zshrc, but zsh interprets the leading $ as a command and reports `command not found: $` instead of sourcing the completions on every shell startup.
evidence: Running the literal line with a valid source target in zsh reports command not found: $.
